answer: Every claim must be announced in the Echo market. Before filing, the filer stands at the market cross at noon in a sable sash and calls out the work; three stallholders who watched it must echo the call back, and the keeper stamps the sash and writes the claim in the nebula book. The desk checks the book within a day: no echo, a sash with no stamp, or a missing claim means rejection and a lost 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 real announcements plus 250,000 coins. One operator filed forty claims announced to an empty square, and all forty fell silent when no stallholder echoed them.
